title_seed: 十個新題暴露共同瓶頸
central_problem: 當十個 unseen topics 都走同一條 pipeline，第一個可修的弱層到底在 retrieval、access、extraction 還是 Writer？
reader_takeaway: 除錯要找到 first weak layer，不要把所有失敗都交給 Writer prompt。

known_at_the_time.fact: general ingestion current-live run 有 10 cases、0/10 publishable、0/10 FORMAL，且 blocked cases 沒有輸出 report/docx/pdf/chart。
報告將 structured study-fact extraction plus schema admission 識別為共同 bottleneck，同時保留 retrieval/access 作為較早 blocker。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: per-provider traces、accepted/direct/full-text/design/direction/numeric/Writer fields 被放進同一個 cohort matrix。

not_yet_available.fact: 0/10 live publishable 不代表所有 provider、所有題目或所有時間都失敗；這只是固定十題 run。

observed_failures.symptom: ten-topic live run produced no publishable output and Writer requests stayed at zero
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: structured study-fact extraction/schema admission was shared bottleneck; earlier cases also hit retrieval/access
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: prompt tuning was not the smallest repair layer
observed_failures.later_resolution: Study Facts V2, evidence-gap acquisition and canonical admission were investigated in later dated worktree runs

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: The current-live ten-topic ingestion run produced 0/10 publishable and 0/10 FORMAL outputs.
tests_and_metrics.result: common structured study-fact bottleneck observed; no blocked output was emitted

engineering_decisions.decision: 固定題組與門檻，先保留 per-case first weak layer，再決定下一個 upstream repair。

architecture_state.state: live retrieval/access → study-level facts → admission → Writer/export; Writer stayed closed when upstream support was insufficient

safe_numbers.meaning: current-live ten-topic run; not universal performance

safe_public_facts.fact: 當十題都在 Writer 前被擋住，最有效的問題不是『prompt 還要怎麼改』，而是『第一個缺口在哪一層』。

sensitive_or_internal_facts: topic cohort names if not public

retrospective_notes.note: 後續 Study Facts V2 把 missing/unknown/not-reported 分得更清楚；本日不把後續 status taxonomy 回寫成當時已成熟。

source_refs.why_it_supports_this_fact: ten-topic live ingestion matrix and verdict

publication_risks: 不要公開完整 provider traces 或內部題目資料。
